regenerationJustification.cite: tdd SS5.4 (approval/decide: unknown or ineligible choiceId answers -32052; a requirementId that is not the approval's current requirement answers -32053 with currentRequirementId in data) and SS5.13 (the approvals error registry rows for approvalChoiceInvalid and approvalRequirementStale); the host's own approval wire-contract test drives both refusals; the recipe charter is #22934 (approvals UX: stale-requirement and invalid-choice arms)
regenerationJustification.rationale: #22934's approvals charter names the invalid-choice arm. This fixture is the committed approval-round-trip exchange up to the presentation receipt, then one decide carrying a choiceId the host never offered (`allow`), the typed -32052 refusal the host answers (code, kind and data members per SS5.13 and the host's wire contract; the message wording follows the runtime's `choice {choiceId:?} is invalid for approval {approvalId}`), and the corrected once-scoped decide with its accepted ack, resolution without amendment, resumed tool terminal and completed turn. No frame before the refusal differs from approval-round-trip; the refused decide carries its own commandId so the corrected decide is a new command, never a conflicting replay.
